https://mastodon.social/@gpowerf/1175885.name: Dr. G. Power
https://mastodon.social/@gpowerf/1175885.text: I played a little David's Midnight Magic and Midnight Magic tonight. On the C64 and the 2600. The C64 is way quicker with more natural physics, but somehow I prefer the Atari game. Perhaps I'm just used to it. Despite what the game art shows these games cannot be played with paddles. On the 2600 the buttons on the paddles work as the cover indicates, however, you cannot launch the ball. PS: The tables are totally different between these two games. #retrogaming #atari #commodore
